initiatives.name: Action Portfolio Company Expansion and Modernisation
initiatives.summary: 3i completed a major capital restructuring with Action, receiving £1,164 million in proceeds and then reinvesting £768 million to increase its equity stake from 54.8% to 57.9%. This followed Action's €2.1 billion refinancing event in July 2024.

evidence.title: Action Capital Restructuring and Stake Increase
evidence.summary: 3i completed a major capital restructuring with Action, receiving £1,164 million in proceeds and then reinvesting £768 million to increase its equity stake from 54.8% to 57.9%. This followed Action's €2.1 billion refinancing event in July 2024.
evidence.quote: In July 2024, Action raised €2.1 billion through a refinancing event and completed a capital restructuring with a pro-rata share redemption. As a result, 3i received total proceeds of £1,164 million. Alongside several existing LPs in the 2020 Co-Investor Programme, 3i took the opportunity to acquire an additional stake in Action. Including a small subsequent purchase of an existing LP stake later in the year, 3i reinvested £768 million, increasing its gross equity stake from 54.8% to 57.9%.

evidence.title: Action ERP System Implementation
evidence.summary: Action successfully implemented a new enterprise resource planning (ERP) system at the end of 2024 to support its vast and growing store network. The implementation had a minor impact on store availability in Q1 2025 but issues were resolved by March 2025.
evidence.quote: Action also invested in a new enterprise resource planning ("ERP") system, which was successfully implemented at the end of 2024. The implementation had a minor impact on store availability in the first quarter of 2025 and the issues were resolved by March 2025.

evidence.title: Action Distribution Centre Expansion
evidence.summary: Action opened two new distribution centres in Spain and Italy during 2024, expanding its DC network to 15 across Europe. The company has three additional new DCs planned for 2025 to support its growing store network of 2,967 stores.
evidence.quote: To support its vast and growing store network, Action continues to invest in its IT infrastructure, systems and distribution channels. In 2024, the business opened two new distribution centres ("DCs") in Illescas, Spain and Altedo, Italy, increasing its DC network to 15 across Europe, with a further three new DCs planned for 2025.

initiatives.name: Action Equity Stake Consolidation
initiatives.summary: 3i significantly increased its equity stake in Action from 57.9% to 65.4% through multiple transactions during the year. This included acquiring approximately 5.1% from GIC in exchange for new 3i shares and reinvesting proceeds from refinancing to acquire additional stakes.

evidence.title: Increased Action stake to 65.4% through multiple acquisitions
evidence.summary: 3i significantly increased its equity stake in Action from 57.9% to 65.4% through multiple transactions during the year. This included acquiring approximately 5.1% from GIC in exchange for new 3i shares and reinvesting proceeds from refinancing to acquire additional stakes.
evidence.quote: In September 2025 and January 2026, we acquired approximately 5.1% of Action's equity from GIC in exchange for the issuance of new ordinary shares in 3i Group plc, representing an equivalent consideration of £1.7 billion. In October 2025, following a further successful refinancing and capital restructuring at Action which returned £944 million of gross proceeds to 3i, we redeployed £755 million to acquire an additional 2.2% stake from existing LPs.

evidence.summary: 3i completed three new investments totaling £318 million: WaterWipes (£121 million), Constellation (£98 million), and OMS Prüfservice (£99 million). These investments align with 3i's focus on sectors they know well including consumer brands, IT services, and industrial testing.

initiatives.summary: 3i's near-term science-based emissions reduction targets were validated by the Science Based Targets initiative in March 2024. Seven portfolio companies across 3i Group have now set approved science-based targets, including Action which received validation in February 2025.

evidence.title: Science-Based Targets Validation
evidence.summary: 3i's near-term science-based emissions reduction targets were validated by the Science Based Targets initiative in March 2024. Seven portfolio companies across 3i Group have now set approved science-based targets, including Action which received validation in February 2025.
evidence.quote: We were pleased to announce in May 2024 that our near-term science-based emissions reduction targets ("science-based targets") had been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative ("SBTi") in March 2024. These targets cover our direct greenhouse gas ("GHG") emissions (Scope 1 and 2, market-based), as well as those related to our portfolio. We have made significant progress in relation to our portfolio engagement target, with seven portfolio companies across 3i Group and 3i Infrastructure plc ("3iN") having set approved science-based targets as at 31 March 2025, including most notably Action.

initiatives.name: Portfolio Company Exit Programme
initiatives.summary: 3i completed the exit of two portfolio companies generating £659 million in total proceeds. The sale of nexeye delivered £382 million with a 2.0x sterling money multiple, while the realisation of WP generated £280 million with a 2.2x sterling money multiple.

evidence.title: Two Major Portfolio Company Realisations
evidence.summary: 3i completed the exit of two portfolio companies generating £659 million in total proceeds. The sale of nexeye delivered £382 million with a 2.0x sterling money multiple, while the realisation of WP generated £280 million with a 2.2x sterling money multiple.
evidence.quote: We completed two significant realisations during the year, generating total proceeds of £659 million. Since acquiring nexeye in 2017, the company has driven growth both organically and through a buy-and-build strategy, expanding its store base from approximately 400 to over 700 across five countries. This realisation, which completed in July 2024, delivered a modest profit over its 31 March 2024 valuation, generating proceeds of £382 million. When combined with distributions received during our ownership, this resulted in a sterling money multiple of 2.0x. We also completed the realisation of WP, an asset we had held since 2015. The transaction generated total proceeds of £280 million, including interest income of £3 million, reflecting an 18% profit over its 31 March 2024 valuation. Including the £45 million received earlier in our ownership period, this resulted in a sterling money multiple of 2.2x.
